<section class="grid g3">
  <div><h2>What you'll work on</h2><p class="muted">Computer vision on satellite imagery and LLMs for environmental policy; VLMs and sensing for respiratory health; time-series models for energy; multimodal models for social good.</p><a class="arrow" href="research.html">Current research</a></div>
  <div><h2>How you'll learn</h2><p class="muted">New to research? That's fine. New members start with the Research Skills Bootcamp, then weekly group meetings, a reading group and shared GPU servers.</p><a class="arrow" href="https://sustainability-lab.github.io/sustainability-research-bootcamp/">Research Skills Bootcamp</a></div>
  <div><h2>Where you'll go</h2><p class="muted">Alumni are at Cambridge, Microsoft Research, Google DeepMind, CMU, UIUC, Oracle and Nykaa, and in PhD programmes worldwide.</p><a class="arrow" href="people.html#alumni-list">Alumni</a></div>
</section>
